resolution: Disabled the d.mehta account, revoked all group memberships and tokens, and transferred owned resources to their manager.

title: Wi-Fi outage at Mumbai HQ
description: [TCK-18567] Issue summary: the wireless network at Mumbai HQ is down and no devices can associate to any access point. It started earlier today and has not self-resolved.
resolution: The wireless controller at Mumbai HQ had lost its config after a power event; restored the configuration and access points came back online.

title: Procurement Portal crashes on file upload
description: [TCK-54433] Support desk logged the following: Procurement Portal crashes with a 502 whenever a user attempts to upload a file larger than a few megabytes. Awaiting assignment to the right team.
resolution: Raised the upload body-size limit in the Procurement Portal reverse proxy and worker config, then verified large uploads complete successfully.

title: Storage quota exceeded for Mumbai HQ
description: [TCK-91776] We are observing that the Mumbai HQ team has hit its storage quota and can no longer save new files to their share. Requesting priority attention from the relevant team.
resolution: Reviewed usage for Mumbai HQ, archived stale data to cold storage, and raised their quota after manager approval.

title: High CPU on server STG-APP-07
description: [TCK-22224] Reported by the Hyderabad Office team: sustained CPU utilization above 95% on STG-APP-07 for the last 40 minutes, causing request timeouts. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Identified a runaway process on STG-APP-07, capped its cgroup CPU quota, and scaled the service horizontally to shed load.

title: Firewall blocking port 9092
description: [TCK-34654] Reported by the Mumbai HQ team: a required service is unreachable because traffic on port 9092 appears to be blocked by the firewall. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Added an explicit firewall allow rule for port 9092 scoped to the required source ranges and verified the service became reachable.

title: NTP time drift on PRD-DB-11
description: [TCK-10012] Reported by the Delhi Sales team: PRD-DB-11 clock has drifted several seconds, breaking token validation and log correlation. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Reconfigured chrony on PRD-DB-11 to use the internal NTP pool and forced an immediate sync; drift returned to sub-millisecond.

title: Unpatched critical CVE on PRD-CACHE-03
description: [TCK-87059] Flagged during routine checks: vulnerability scanning found a critical, actively-exploited CVE unpatched on PRD-CACHE-03. Please confirm root cause and next steps.
resolution: Applied the vendor security patch to PRD-CACHE-03 during an emergency change window and rescanned to confirm the CVE was remediated.

title: Snapshot/backup restore request for \\nas03\media
description: [TCK-97552] Monitoring alerted us that a user accidentally deleted a folder on \\nas03\media and needs yesterday's version restored. Escalating for investigation.
resolution: Restored the requested folder on \\nas03\media from the previous night's snapshot and confirmed file integrity with the requesting user.

title: Billing Portal extremely slow to load
description: [TCK-51119] Flagged during routine checks: the Billing Portal application takes over 30 seconds to load pages, up from the usual sub-second response. Please confirm root cause and next steps.
resolution: A missing database index behind Billing Portal was causing full table scans; added the index and enabled query caching, restoring fast page loads.

title: Unauthorized privilege escalation detected for r.desai
description: [TCK-42997] Reported by the Mumbai HQ team: audit logs show account r.desai was granted administrator rights outside the normal approval workflow. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Revoked the unauthorized admin rights from r.desai, traced the change to a misconfigured group policy, and tightened the privileged-access approval controls.

title: Permissions incorrect on \\nas05\engineering
description: [TCK-27467] Support desk logged the following: several Pune Branch users report they can see the folder \\nas05\engineering but get 'access denied' when opening files inside it. Awaiting assignment to the right team.
resolution: Corrected the inherited NTFS permissions on \\nas05\engineering for the relevant Pune Branch group and re-propagated ACLs so the files opened as expected.

title: File share \\nas05\engineering inaccessible
description: [TCK-40166] Issue summary: users cannot access the network file share \\nas05\engineering; it returns 'network path not found'. It started earlier today and has not self-resolved.
resolution: The share service backing \\nas05\engineering had crashed; restarted it, verified permissions, and remapped the share for affected users.

title: Elevated access request for n.gupta
description: [TCK-60785] Flagged during routine checks: user n.gupta has requested temporary admin access to Field Service App to complete a project task. Please confirm root cause and next steps.
resolution: Granted n.gupta time-boxed elevated access to Field Service App via the privileged-access workflow with automatic expiry after 7 days.

title: Malware detected on endpoint of d.mehta
description: [TCK-92685] Ticket raised because the EDR agent flagged and quarantined a trojan on the workstation belonging to d.mehta. This is impacting daily work.
resolution: Isolated the endpoint of d.mehta from the network, ran a full offline scan to remove the trojan, and re-imaged the machine as a precaution.

title: Slow read/write on \\nas03\projects
description: [TCK-58816] Reported by the Mumbai HQ team: read and write performance on \\nas03\projects has degraded severely, with file operations timing out. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: A failing disk in the array behind \\nas03\projects was causing rebuild-related slowness; replaced the disk and performance returned to normal.

title: Vendor Portal scheduled report emails not sending
description: [TCK-52336] Reported by the Remote/WFH team: the scheduled report emails from Vendor Portal have silently stopped going out and users are not receiving their daily summaries. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: The outbound mail worker for Vendor Portal had a stuck queue after an SMTP change; updated the mailer settings, drained the queue, and confirmed reports resumed.

title: High latency to PRD-DB-12
description: [TCK-62852] We are observing that network latency to PRD-DB-12 has spiked to hundreds of milliseconds, degrading application response. Requesting priority attention from the relevant team.
resolution: Traced the latency to a saturated link on the path to PRD-DB-12; rerouted traffic over a secondary path and opened a capacity request.

title: Malware detected on endpoint of s.khan
description: [TCK-39076] Reported by the Noida Tech Park team: the EDR agent flagged and quarantined a trojan on the workstation belonging to s.khan. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Isolated the endpoint of s.khan from the network, ran a full offline scan to remove the trojan, and re-imaged the machine as a precaution.

title: Server PRD-APP-04 unresponsive after reboot
description: [TCK-92306] We are observing that PRD-APP-04 failed to come back online following a scheduled reboot and is not responding to SSH or ping. Requesting priority attention from the relevant team.
resolution: Console access to PRD-APP-04 showed a failed fstab mount blocking boot; corrected the mount entry and the host booted cleanly.

title: Password reset for m.chatterjee
description: [TCK-14577] Reported by the Remote/WFH team: user m.chatterjee is locked out and has requested a password reset for their corporate account. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Verified the identity of m.chatterjee, reset the password, and required a change plus MFA re-registration at next login.

title: DNS resolution failing for Ticketing System
description: [TCK-70621] User s.joshi reports that clients cannot resolve the hostname for Ticketing System, receiving NXDOMAIN responses. Kindly look into this at the earliest.
resolution: A stale DNS record for Ticketing System was corrected on the authoritative server and the resolver caches were flushed, restoring resolution.

title: Wi-Fi outage at Pune Branch
description: [TCK-82499] Ticket raised because the wireless network at Pune Branch is down and no devices can associate to any access point. This is impacting daily work.
resolution: The wireless controller at Pune Branch had lost its config after a power event; restored the configuration and access points came back online.

title: SSO access failing for t.rao to GCP
description: [TCK-94567] Ticket raised because user t.rao cannot reach the GCP application through single sign-on and is bounced back to the login screen. This is impacting daily work.
resolution: Found t.rao was missing from the GCP SSO assignment group; added them to the group and confirmed federated login to GCP succeeded.

title: Can't pull up records in Procurement Portal
description: [TCK-74463] Ticket raised because trying to view customer or order records in Procurement Portal just spins and then shows an error saying it cannot reach the records system. This is impacting daily work.
resolution: The application server's connection pool to customers_pg had exhausted; restarted the pooler and verified Procurement Portal could reach customers_pg again, restoring record lookups.

title: Brute-force attack against Vendor Portal login
description: [TCK-40818] Support desk logged the following: monitoring shows a high-volume password-guessing attack hammering the Vendor Portal login endpoint from many IP addresses. Awaiting assignment to the right team.
resolution: Enabled rate limiting and account lockout on the Vendor Portal login endpoint, added the attacking ranges to a block list, and turned on CAPTCHA after repeated failures.

title: Automatic scaling not triggering for VM-BATCH-09
description: [TCK-63856] User s.khan reports that the autoscaling group for VM-BATCH-09 is not adding capacity even though CPU has been pinned high for over an hour. Kindly look into this at the earliest.
resolution: Found the autoscaling policy for VM-BATCH-09 referenced a stale metric; corrected the scaling metric and cooldown, and new instances now launch on demand.

title: Phishing email reported by a.patel
description: [TCK-51331] User a.patel reports that user a.patel reported a phishing email with a credential-harvesting link that several staff may have clicked. Kindly look into this at the earliest.
resolution: Removed the phishing message from all mailboxes via mail-flow rules, blocked the sender domain, and reset passwords for affected users.

title: Memory exhaustion on VM-BATCH-09
description: [TCK-44931] Reported by the Chennai Support team: VM-BATCH-09 is reporting out-of-memory kills and the OOM killer has terminated critical services. Please investigate and resolve.
resolution: Increased the memory limit for the affected container on VM-BATCH-09 and added a memory-usage alert at 80% to catch it earlier.

title: Autovacuum not keeping up on reporting_mongo
description: [TCK-52026] We are observing that reporting_mongo is showing severe table bloat and rising query times because dead tuples are accumulating faster than they are cleaned up. Requesting priority attention from the relevant team.
resolution: Tuned the autovacuum thresholds and cost limits on reporting_mongo, ran a manual vacuum on the worst tables, and query performance and disk usage recovered.

title: Expired TLS certificate on Billing Portal
description: [TCK-38389] Ticket raised because the TLS certificate for Billing Portal has expired and browsers are showing security warnings to all users. This is impacting daily work.
resolution: Reissued and installed a valid TLS certificate for Billing Portal, then configured auto-renewal via ACME to prevent recurrence.
